pictures.name: ST1-Twin-Trees
pictures.prompt: A quiet grove of tall sal trees near ancient Kusinara at dusk. Between two great sal trees, on a simple cloth-covered couch, rests the Buddha (shown in the traditional respectful way: serene aged face, short grey curls, eyes gently half-closed, a simple saffron robe), lying peacefully on his right side, head resting on his hand. A few monks sit at a respectful distance with palms together. Peaceful, reverent, deep blue twilight, warm gold light on the trees. Contemplative sacred oil painting, one tall 9:16 picture, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow quiet mood, main subject in the middle of the frame.
